settings.title: Match rules
settings.explanation: These rules apply to both players and every round in this match.
settings.speedCap: Speed pickups add one level at a time, up to 5 cells/s.
settings.kickDescription: Permanent equipment that kicks a stationary timed or remote bomb when you walk into it. The bomb moves one tile on the next update, then every 10 updates until blocked; its owner and fuse stay unchanged. Contact mines cannot be kicked, and another equipment pickup replaces Kick.
settings.punchDescription: Permanent equipment. Press your Equipment key to punch the bomb directly ahead to the next open floor cell in its three-tile path. After a successful punch, Punch has a fixed 0.2 second cooldown; another equipment pickup replaces Punch.
settings.braceletDescription: Permanent equipment. Moving forward into the other player shoves them up to 1 tile. After a successful shove, Bracelet has a 0.5 second cooldown and must separate before it can shove again; another equipment pickup replaces Bracelet.
settings.wallPassDescription: Permanent equipment that lets you move through breakable blocks. Hard walls and bombs still block you, explosions still hurt, and another equipment pickup replaces it. After replacement, you may leave a block you already overlap but cannot re-enter it.
settings.heartDescription: Absorbs one lethal blast, then grants a brief damage grace period.
settings.remoteBombDescription: Stores one remotely triggered bomb. Place it with the bomb key, then press the same key later to detonate it.
settings.piercingBombDescription: Stores one special bomb whose blast passes through breakable blocks. The charge is used only when you successfully place it.
settings.powerBombDescription: Stores one special bomb whose blast fills a diamond-shaped area, ignoring obstruction while leaving hard walls intact. The charge is used only when you successfully place it.
settings.landmineDescription: Stores one visible pressure mine. Everyone standing on it when placed may leave safely; entering it later detonates it. Fire and other blasts destroy it without an explosion.
settings.shieldDescription: Grants 5 seconds of damage immunity. Picking up another Shield refreshes it.
settings.stopwatchDescription: Freezes the opponent's movement and manual bomb action and pauses all timed bomb fuses for 3 seconds. Another Stopwatch refreshes it.
settings.invisibilityCloakDescription: Hides your actor and attributable cues from the opponent for 10 seconds. Public bombs and flames remain visible.
settings.invisibleBombsDescription: Hides every bomb and its placement or detonation cue from you for 10 seconds. Bombs still block movement, consume capacity and create visible flames.
settings.oilBarrelDescription: Adds up to 8 Oil Barrel objects per round. An unlit barrel blocks movement and bombs; explosions ignite it into passable fire that burns for the rest of the round. Wall Pass can cross an unlit barrel but does not protect you from its fire.
settings.teleporterDescription: Consumes immediately. Swaps both players only when both landing areas are safe; an unsafe pickup is still consumed without moving either player.
settings.goldenFlameDescription: Maximizes new bomb blasts for 10 seconds. Picking up another Golden flame refreshes it.
settings.shortFuseDescription: Halves the fuse of new bombs for 10 seconds. Picking up another Short fuse refreshes it.
settings.diarrheaDescription: Automatically drops ordinary bombs for 10 seconds whenever placement is possible and you have spare capacity. Another pickup refreshes the timer.
settings.slowFootDescription: Halves movement speed for 10 seconds. Up to 6 pickups stack, and each has its own timer.
settings.shortFlameDescription: Limits new bomb blasts to 1 tile for 10 seconds, overriding Golden flame. Existing bombs stay unchanged; range bonuses resume afterward. Another pickup refreshes it.
settings.longFuseDescription: Doubles the fuse of new bombs for 10 seconds. Short and Long fuse cancel while both are active; existing bombs stay unchanged. Another pickup refreshes it.
settings.reverseControlsDescription: Reverses movement controls for 10 seconds. Held keys stay physically held; another pickup refreshes the timer.
settings.unapplied: Apply these changes before readying up.
settings.lockedReady: Become not ready to edit the rules.
settings.lockedMatch: Rules are locked after the match starts.
